description:
Hey space enthusiasts! We love combining creativity with technology to solve galactic challenges—whether through design, coding, or storytelling.

Interests: We bring a mix of creative design, frontend/UI, and general problem-solving. We’re all about positive vibes, team bonding, and turning big cosmic ideas into reality!

Who we need: 

Developers

Coders Data Enthusiasts 

Creative minds & writers

 If you’re eager to learn, build, and have fun, jump aboard our crew!
